caption:
The will still judge you 

#healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #mindfulness
transcript: They will still judge you, they will still doubt you, they will still speak behind your back, and some of them will try to pull you down, not because you are weak, but because your growth reminds them of what they avoid within themselves. They will try to make you smaller, they will question your choices, they will project their fear onto your path. Understand this quietly, these are not people who truly love you. Love does not drain your energy, love does not confuse your spirit, love does not ask you to betray yourself to belong. There comes a moment in life when you must release certain people, not with confrontation, not with explanation, but by withdrawing your energy, and here is a simple practice for the next time this happens. When you feel pulled down, when you feel their words entering your mind, pause, gently say inside yourself, enough, then remind yourself, I am not going to spend my energy on someone who does not wish me well. I choose to listen to my heart, I choose to walk my own path. You do not need to argue, you do not need to prove, you do not need to react. Silence is also a response. Each time you choose not to engage, your power returns to you. Your mind becomes calmer, your direction becomes clearer, and slowly without force your life begins to rise again.
